Server API

group BLOB_TRANSFER_SERVER_API

Functions for server operations.

Functions

bool blob_transfer_server_reg(uint8_t element_index, model_data_cb_pf model_data_cb)

Register BLOB transfer server.

Registers the BLOB transfer server model on a specific element.

参数:

  • element_index -- [in] The index of the element where the model is to be registered.

  • model_data_cb -- [in] Callback function for model data processing.

返回值:

  • true -- Registration is successful.

  • false -- Registration failed.

返回:

Registration result.

void blob_transfer_server_set_data_cb(model_data_cb_pf model_data_cb)

Set the BLOB transfer server model data callback function.

Sets the callback function to handle model data for the server.

参数:

model_data_cb -- [in] The model data callback function.

void blob_transfer_server_caps_set(blob_server_capabilities_t *pcaps)

Set BLOB transfer server capabilities.

Configures the capabilities of the BLOB transfer server.

参数:

pcaps -- [in] Pointer to the server's capabilities configuration structure.

blob_server_capabilities_t blob_transfer_server_caps_get(void)

Get BLOB transfer server capabilities.

Retrieves the configured capabilities of the BLOB transfer server.

返回值:

blob_server_capabilities_t -- The capabilities structure.

返回:

The server capabilities structure.

bool blob_transfer_server_init(uint8_t blob_id[8], uint16_t transfer_timeout, uint8_t transfer_ttl)

Initialize the BLOB transfer server.

Initializes the server for BLOB transfer with a specified BLOB ID, timeout, and TTL.

参数:

  • blob_id -- [in] The identifier for the BLOB (8 bytes).

  • transfer_timeout -- [in] Timeout duration for transfer in seconds, default is 60.

  • transfer_ttl -- [in] Time-to-Live value for transfer, default is 5.

返回值:

  • true -- Initialization is successful.

  • false -- Initialization failed due to incorrect parameters.

返回:

Initialization result.

bool blob_transfer_server_load(uint32_t blob_size, uint32_t block_size, uint16_t start_block_num, blob_transfer_mode_t transfer_mode, uint16_t transfer_mtu_size, uint16_t updater_addr, uint16_t updater_app_key_index)

Load BLOB transfer procedure.

Prepares the BLOB transfer procedure with specified parameters.

参数:

  • blob_size -- [in] The total size of the BLOB.

  • block_size -- [in] The size of each block in the transfer.

  • start_block_num -- [in] The starting block number.

  • transfer_mode -- [in] The mode of transfer (Server Data).

  • transfer_mtu_size -- [in] The MTU size for the transfer.

  • updater_addr -- [in] The address of the updater.

  • updater_app_key_index -- [in] The app key index of the updater.

返回值:

  • true -- Loading is successful.

  • false -- Loading failed due to invalid parameters.

返回:

Load result.

void blob_transfer_server_clear(void)

Clear the BLOB transfer server.

Resets the internal state of the BLOB transfer server.

blob_transfer_phase_t blob_transfer_server_phase_get(void)

Get the phase of the BLOB transfer server.

Retrieves the current phase of the BLOB transfer server.

返回值:

blob_transfer_phase_t -- The server phase.

返回:

Current phase of the server.

bool blob_transfer_server_busy(void)

Check if the BLOB transfer server is busy.

Determines if the server is currently busy with a BLOB transfer.

返回值:

  • true -- Server is busy.

  • false -- Server is idle.

返回:

Busy state of the server.

void blob_transfer_handle_transfer_timeout(void)

Handle BLOB transfer server timeout event.

Processes timeout events for BLOB transfers.

void blob_transfer_handle_pull_timeout(void)

Handle BLOB transfer partial block report timeout event.

Processes timeout events for partial block reports in BLOB transfers.

mesh_msg_send_cause_t blob_transfer_status(uint16_t dst, uint16_t app_key_index, blob_transfer_status_code_t status, uint32_t delay_time)

Send BLOB transfer status.

Sends the current status of the BLOB transfer to a destination address.

参数:

  • dst -- [in] The destination address.

  • app_key_index -- [in] The app key index used for sending.

  • status -- [in] The current BLOB transfer status code.

  • delay_time -- [in] Delay in milliseconds before sending, default is 0.

返回值:

  • MESH_MSG_SEND_CAUSE_SUCCESS -- Status sent successfully.

  • Others -- Failed to send status due to network issues.

返回:

Send operation result.

mesh_msg_send_cause_t blob_block_status(uint16_t dst, uint16_t app_key_index, blob_transfer_status_code_t status, uint32_t delay_time)

Send BLOB block status.

Sends the status of a specific BLOB block to a destination address.

参数:

  • dst -- [in] The destination address.

  • app_key_index -- [in] The app key index used for sending.

  • status -- [in] The current BLOB block status code.

  • delay_time -- [in] Delay in milliseconds before sending, default is 0.

返回值:

  • MESH_MSG_SEND_CAUSE_SUCCESS -- Block status sent successfully.

  • Others -- Failed to send block status due to network issues.

返回:

Send operation result.

mesh_msg_send_cause_t blob_partial_block_report(uint16_t dst, uint16_t app_key_index)

Send BLOB partial block report.

Sends a partial block report for the BLOB transfer to a destination address.

参数:

  • dst -- [in] The destination address.

  • app_key_index -- [in] The app key index used for sending.

返回值:

  • MESH_MSG_SEND_CAUSE_SUCCESS -- Partial block report sent successfully.

  • Others -- Failed to send partial block report due to invalid parameters.

返回:

Send operation result.

mesh_msg_send_cause_t blob_info_status(uint16_t dst, uint16_t app_key_index, uint32_t delay_time)

Send BLOB information status.

Sends the current BLOB information to a destination address.

参数:

  • dst -- [in] The destination address.

  • app_key_index -- [in] The app key index used for sending.

  • delay_time -- [in] Delay in milliseconds before sending, default is 0.

返回值:

  • MESH_MSG_SEND_CAUSE_SUCCESS -- Information status sent successfully.

  • Others -- Failed to send information status due to network congestion.

返回:

Send operation result.
